integrity: The general statement has an explicit algebraic proof. The standalone checker exhaustively tests finite examples; those tests are corroboration, not a proof for arbitrary groups.
scientific_limitations: This identifies the least medial congruence on conjugation quandles of generalized-dihedral groups with any abelian kernel; it does not address arbitrary conjugation quandles or other identities. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Universal medialization of generalized-dihedral conjugation quandles
